name: POST /api/leadflow/meetings/book-live - booked while they are on the call
description:
A SEPARATE ENDPOINT FROM THE ORDINARY BOOKING, deliberately. Booking live is a different act: the prospect is on the phone, the invite must exist before the call ends, and a failure has to surface to the rep IMMEDIATELY rather than land in a queue — "I'll send that over" is how a booked meeting becomes a meeting nobody turns up to.

THE AGENDA IS REQUIRED. A meeting booked live with no stated agenda is one the prospect cannot prepare for and the rep cannot be held to, and it is the strongest predictor of a no-show.

The reminder ladder is returned so the rep can say, on the call, exactly what the customer will receive — a confirmation the rep cannot describe is one the customer does not believe.

requestBody.agenda: Walk through the pipeline board and agree next steps.

testCases.name: A meeting is booked live with its reminder ladder set

requestBody.agenda: Walk through the pipeline board and agree next steps.

testCases.name: A live booking with no agenda is REFUSED
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all

errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.
